content.text: March Madness scores SN 140 The Archive Shop Tickets March 22, 2026 4:51 am UTC Imagn Images Add The Sporting News on Google The No. 4 seed Arkansas Razorbacks (27-8) will face the No. 12 seed High Point Panthers (31-4) in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. Arkansas won the SEC Tournament last week, and it added to its momentum with a 97-78 win over No. 13 seed Hawaii on Thursday.High Point won the Big South regular season and tournament titles before knocking off No. 5 seed Wisconsin in the first round on Thursday. The Panthers have won 15 consecutive games, overcoming an eight-point deficit against the Badgers.
